tools.name: get_user_profile
tools.description: Profile snapshot: CEFR level, target/source languages, due card count, weak words, recent lookups. Pass `lang` to scope the snapshot to one learning language (for users learning several); omit it for the user's primary language.

tools.name: get_system_instructions
tools.description: Call this at the START of every new conversation, before your first reply, to load the user's Minddory setup and your role as their proactive language partner: CEFR level, target/source languages, due-card count, weak words, and how to capture. tools.name: get_known_words
tools.description: Words the user has verified known via flashcard practice. Paginated keyset on flashcards.id.

tools.name: get_queue
tools.description: Cards due now and due within the next 24 hours.

tools.name: get_card
tools.description: Single card detail by word (case-insensitive). Returns translation, mastery, and last 10 events.

tools.name: get_recent_activity
tools.description: Event log slice with optional surface filter and keyset pagination on answers.id.

tools.name: log_interaction
tools.description: Append a generic interaction event to the answers log. Use for lookups, AI discussions, and reading-in-context signals.

tools.name: mark_demonstrated
tools.description: Confidence-weighted spaced-repetition boost when the user has used a word correctly: the card moves further out in the review schedule. Logs an answer row even if no flashcard exists.

tools.name: mark_struggled
tools.description: Spaced-repetition degrade for a word the user just got wrong: the card comes back sooner. ease_factor drops, interval resets, repetitions reset.

tools.name: capture_word
tools.description: Capture a target-language word or phrase to the user's Minddory vocabulary deck (a flashcard in the "Chat Discoveries" folder when the word is new, otherwise a context encounter). The user connected Minddory so their assistant builds their deck from real conversations, so use this proactively to log

tools.name: capture_grammar_mistake
tools.description: Log a grammar mistake the user just made in the target language, creating a grammar point in their Minddory deck. tools.name: get_active_vocab
tools.description: Get the user's most actively encountered target-language words (from past capture_word + log_interaction events), ranked by frequency over a lookback window. Use to surface "frontier" words the user keeps touching when they ask "what should I learn next" or when you want context-aware suggestions.

tools.name: check_words
tools.description: Batch lookup: for a list of target-language words, tell me which ones are already in the user's Minddory deck and how well they know each.
